data.summary: The reports directory contains analytical SQL queries for data warehouse reporting, focusing on category revenue, customer tier performance, and Taipei timezone-adjusted daily revenue metrics.

file_insights.name: category_revenue_rank.sql
file_insights.summary: Queries all-time revenue and order counts grouped by category and rank.
file_insights.source_summary: Selects revenue_rank, category, revenue, and order_count from iceberg.dwh_spark.ads_category_revenue_rank.
file_insights.detailed_description: Retrieves all-time revenue per category directly from the ADS table without day bucketing.

file_insights.name: customer_upgrade_before_after.sql
file_insights.summary: Analyzes customer order statistics before and after membership tier upgrades.
file_insights.source_summary: Joins fact_orders with dim_customer for customer_id = 1, grouping by membership tier and aggregating orders and revenue.
file_insights.detailed_description: Tracks customer upgrades and computes orders and revenue for a specific customer across membership tiers.
responsibilities: Analyze customer order patterns across tier upgrades
Convert order timestamps to Taipei time

file_insights.name: daily_revenue_taipei.sql
file_insights.summary: Computes daily revenue and orders per category using Taipei time conversion.
file_insights.source_summary: Selects taipei_day and category, summing line amounts and counting distinct orders from fact_orders and dim_product.
file_insights.detailed_description: Aggregates daily revenue and orders per category by converting UTC order timestamps to Taipei local time at the edge.
responsibilities: Aggregate daily revenue and order counts by category

file_insights.name: tier_summary.sql
file_insights.summary: Provides a summary of order metrics and average order value segmented by historical customer membership tiers.
file_insights.source_summary: Aggregates fact_orders joined with dim_customer grouped by membership_tier to calculate orders, revenue, and average order value.
file_insights.detailed_description: Summarizes total orders, revenue, and average order value grouped by the customer membership tier active at the time of ordering.
responsibilities: Summarize revenue and order count by membership tier
Calculate average order value per tier
